$comment: Planner names and decisions the game tables don't link. See README.md in this folder.

domainNames.$comment: Domain entrance names, keyed by the entrance's Mon/Thu family (its lowest-tier GOOD key). The build warns when a name is not in the game's text.

weeklyBossNames.$comment: Boss names, keyed by the lowest-id material of its trio. Only needed where the game data names none (bosses outside domains) or names it badly.

unfarmable.$comment: Weekly materials that no weekly boss drops and Dream Solvent cannot make, with the reason. The build fails on any other weekly material outside a trio.
unfarmable.TheCornerstoneOfStarsAndFlames: Reward of Natlan regional quests; in no Dream Solvent recipe and no weekly boss preview
